# Subtle Sayak

> Subtle Sayak is a UI/UX designer and interaction design graduate based in Bengaluru, India. This portfolio presents client websites, UI/UX, branding, visual design, research, prototyping, data visualization, 3D, rendering, photography, and product storytelling work.

Public profile context: UI/UX Designer and interaction design graduate based in Bengaluru, India, focused on user experience, interface design, visual systems, branding, prototyping, photography, and product storytelling.

Last updated: August 2026.

## Main Pages
- [Portfolio](https://subtlesayak.github.io/): Client websites, selected case studies, and the main project grid.
- [Photography](https://subtlesayak.github.io/photography.html): Photography collections, visual galleries, and the People I Meet portrait series.
- [Articles](https://subtlesayak.github.io/articles.html): Articles, notes, and process writing.
- [Projects](https://subtlesayak.github.io/projects.html): Public web projects, tools, and GitHub Pages apps.
- [About](https://subtlesayak.github.io/about.html): Profile, skills, software, education, projects, certificates, and contact links.
- [Sitemap](https://subtlesayak.github.io/sitemap.html): Human-readable site map.

## Client Websites
- [Red Studio Collective](https://redstudiocollective.com/): Service and booking website for a 2,800 sq ft creative studio, including sets, equipment, packages, featured work, and enquiries.
- [Red Productions](https://www.redproductions.in/): Conversion-focused website for a Bengaluru production studio, covering positioning, services, portfolio, team, and project enquiries.
- [More Than Red](https://www.morethanred.in/): Editorial portfolio website for wedding photography and films, with stories, films, testimonials, and enquiries.

## Public Projects
- [SayaQR](https://subtlesayak.github.io/SayaQR/): Privacy-first browser QR code generator with multiple QR modes, export options, design controls, scannability checks, batch CSV mode, and offline PWA support. Source: https://github.com/subtlesayak/SayaQR.
- [OpenDash](https://github.com/subtlesayak/open-dash): Open-source Android companion for bike dash navigation, garage, expenses, wallpapers, and ride history.
- [AgeLapse Material](http://agelapse.com): Web experiment that aligns face pictures and creates stabilized aging time-lapses. Source: https://github.com/subtlesayak/agelapse-Material.
- [Portfolio Template](https://github.com/subtlesayak/portfolio-template): Beginner-editable plain HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and text-file portfolio template.
